verdict.rationale: The EC&VC pages describe a dedicated team for high-growth companies and offer free investor-readiness and cap table tools. None of the evidence shows a startup package with deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms. The published fee schedules cover immigration and employment-tribunal work, not startups, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes a startup package — deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms — on its own pages
